description: This file defines a React functional component 'SyncDashboardState' that synchronizes dashboard state with local storage, including functions for managing dashboard context data and selectors for extracting relevant state slices.

classes.name: SyncDashboardState
classes.description: React functional component that synchronizes dashboard state with local storage based on dashboardPageId.

methods.name: getDashboardContextLocalStorage
methods.description: Retrieves dashboard contexts from local storage, filtering out redundant entries.

methods.name: updateDashboardTabLocalStorage
methods.description: Updates local storage with the current dashboard context for a given dashboardPageId.

methods.name: selectDashboardContextForExplore
methods.description: Selector that derives dashboard context data from Redux state, including filters, color schemes, and configuration.
